rollups.text: Purchases and possessions mentioned by the user: a handbag and sunglasses bought at a garage sale around 2023-04-25; shoes bought online from Nordstrom Rack around 2023-05-04; a top and leggings bought at Target around 2023-05-11; a dress and trousers bought during Banana Republic’s friends-and-family sale around 2023-04-13; boots and a sweater bought at Macy’s during an undated Black Friday sale; moisturizer and an eyeshadow palette bought during an undated Sephora VIB sale before Black Friday; a silver necklace for the user’s sister’s birthday on February 15, year unspecified; a 4K television bought at Best Buy during an undated Black Friday sale at 40% off; several discounted video games bought at GameStop during that sale; an HP laptop bought at Best Buy on Black Friday 2022 with a free bag and wireless mouse; a scarf, candle, and chocolates bought as family gifts at a neighborhood holiday market in 2022; a $50 “City Lights” photography print bought on 2023-05-24; and a onesie with a funny quote bought at a vintage clothing store on Main Street on 2023-05-28 as a baby-shower gift.

Art and cultural experiences: during the week of 2023-05-17 to 2023-05-23, the user visited the Photography Gallery’s “Urban Landscapes” exhibition and admired its black-and-white nighttime cityscapes; on 2023-05-24, the user said they had bought the exhibition’s “City Lights” print for $50 and displayed it in the living room. On 2023-05-24, the user also said they had visited an Impressionist Exhibition at the Modern Art Museum, spending hours admiring Claude Monet’s “Water Lilies” and “Impression, Sunrise.” The user owns an abstract painting from their aunt, hung on the living room’s east wall; by 2023-05-28, the user was considering complementary works and expressed interest in Abstract Expressionism, especially Jackson Pollock and Willem de Kooning.

Birding and wildlife experiences: on 2023-05-16, the user spotted a Brown Thrasher during an evening neighborhood walk and coaxed it out from behind a bush with gentle bird calls; on 2023-05-25, the user was still thinking about the sighting and said it taught them the value of patience and quiet while birding. By 2023-05-25, the user was practicing mimicking a Blue Jay call and volunteering at a local wildlife rehabilitation center, where they had recently helped care for a wounded Red-winged Blackbird and found it rewarding.

Food and drink ideas the user considered: around 2023-05-06, a Cucumber Gin Fizz made with Hendrick’s, which the user found refreshing; on 2023-05-20, a Rosemary Gin Spritz and a Basil Gimlet using balcony-grown herbs; a Bourbon-Glazed Salmon dinner planned for 2023-05-20; a caramelized onion, goat cheese, and thyme tart considered on 2023-05-20, along with other savory tart pairings including goat cheese with chives and parsley, Parmesan with rosemary, blue cheese with parsley or dill, and feta with caramelized onions and thyme; on 2023-05-27, a vegan quinoa bowl with roasted vegetables and an Asian-inspired tofu marinade, with sesame seeds and green onions; on 2023-05-29, Pesto Pasta Primavera with spring vegetables and homemade basil pesto; and cauliflower-crust pizza planned for the weekend of 2023-06-03 to 2023-06-04. These were ideas or plans, not all confirmed as prepared.

The user’s Dittobitty bot battle-system project: on 2023-05-21, the user said the bot did not yet have a battle system and requested help building one, alongside an equipable-weapons system. The user specified abilities: swords may deflect attacks, bows gain bonus damage from AGI, axes may critically hit for 1.8× damage, and maces may stun an opponent for the next turn. R weapons were to combine their weapon ability with mostly physical damage and random added elemental damage; UR weapons were to deal 100% elemental damage while retaining their weapon ability. Both steps occurred on 2023-05-21 (0 days elapsed); no later implementation status is recorded.

The user’s wireless-charging-pad flyer and TechXpo follow-up: on 2023-05-26, the user said the product had received a good response at trade shows and that extra brochures ordered after supplies ran low on TechXpo’s second day arrived just in time for the afternoon rush. The user sought help designing a flyer, intended to emphasize fast charging and universal compatibility, and asked about accessible design software. The user would probably use Canva and planned to put a QR code near the call to action on the back, linking to a dedicated product page. These planning steps were discussed on 2023-05-26; no completed flyer is recorded.

The user’s gift-album project: on 2023-05-25, the user liked a customized photo album as a personalized birthday gift and compared Shutterfly, Snapfish, and Mixbook. The user chose Mixbook for its customizable designs and templates, then planned a short introduction message along the lines of “To my dear friends, thanks for being part of my life's adventures.” The choice and message planning occurred on 2023-05-25 (0 days elapsed); completion of the album is not reported.

The user’s California coast road-trip planning: on 2023-05-25, the user was considering a roughly 5–6-day trip from San Francisco to Los Angeles and liked an itinerary including Big Sur and Julia Pfeiffer Burns State Park. The user chose a Santa Barbara whale-watching tour over kayaking in Monterey for the proposed Day 4, citing never having seen whales in their natural habitat; the user then considered lunch at The Fishouse or Brophy Bros. The user was excited about the coastal drive. Planning occurred on 2023-05-25 (0 days elapsed); no travel date, tour booking, or trip booking is confirmed. Separately, the user recalled a recent road trip with companions that included Highway 1, a hike at Julia Pfeiffer Burns State Park, and a night in a rustic Ventana Wilderness cabin; its date is unspecified.

The user’s yoga practice: by 2023-05-25, the user said they had practiced yoga for about six months, with noticeable gains in flexibility and balance, especially hip flexibility. The user found Warrior II challenging and used a yoga block for support; they had also been experimenting with alternate-nostril breathing and kapalabhati learned through an unnamed app. On 2023-05-25, the user wanted to vary home practice with Vinyasa and Yin videos and deepen practice through pranayama, breathwork, philosophy, and applying yoga philosophy in daily life. The six-month practice duration is reported as of 2023-05-25; no later progress is recorded.

The user’s exploration of Paris activities: on 2023-05-29, after asking about cultural attractions and lesser-known options, the user sought unusual, exciting, adventurous experiences and rejected options they found boring, such as taxidermy displays and old-fashioned carousels. The user responded positively to street-art tours, parkour, ghost tours, and Catacombs exploration. Hot-air balloon rides and flyboarding seemed too scary, so the user asked for less intimidating thrills; electric-boat rides, Segway or bike tours, rooftop bars, escape games, and wine-and-cheese tastings were suggested. The user considered combining activities into an itinerary, but no travel dates or bookings were established. Discussion took place on 2023-05-29 (0 days elapsed).

rollups.text: The user’s income-inequality discussion: on 2023-05-29, the user asked about causes, policy responses, immediate support for financially struggling people, advocacy, and examples of countries that had reduced inequality. The user said the US income gap was frustrating and worried that solutions would take a long time; they also found it encouraging that potential solutions exist and expressed frustration that inequality had persisted for so long. The discussion of causes, solutions, and advocacy occurred on 2023-05-29 (0 days elapsed); no personal advocacy action is reported.

The user described two distinct shopping events on Black Friday 2022: a full day at a mall with friends on 2022-11-25, and a Best Buy laptop purchase that year with a free bag and wireless mouse. The year of the user’s other recalled Black Friday purchases (a 4K television at 40% off, discounted GameStop video games, Macy’s boots and sweater, and shopping for an HP laptop) is not specified and should not be conflated with the 2022 events.
